attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image1 original small card is sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light and crop; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion. The subject is bareheaded with no cap, wearing no eyewear, featuring thick short wavy dark black/grey hair brushed up/back with grey highlights and dark brow hair. The expression is stern with a closed mouth and smooth upper lip/chin, showing no separate moustache or beard. The head leans slightly forward/down with a mild head roll, preserving the source downward tilt and actual lighting. The human anatomy becomes a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body with green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. The rounded chin immediately meets a raised, broadened existing neckline with a very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure; there is no separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. The subject wears a dark grey/green open military jacket over a white open-neck inner shirt/collar with no necktie. Retain only source-exposed small gold/red shoulder fitting areas along the crop, with no hidden chest pins or medals. Preserve the actual source open garment and observed inner collar/neckwear state with coherent front/rear collar overlap and contact shadow. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its exact original color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces are opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. No invented insignia, text, or accessories. Fine primary details that are indistinct in the source stay understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED bust leaning slightly forward/down with original mild head roll, thick short WAVY DARK BLACK/GREY hair brushed up/back with grey highlights, actual dark brow HAIR, stern CLOSED mouth and smooth upper lip/chin with no separate moustache/beard or glasses. The dark shapes above forehead are real WAVY HAIR, not a cap. Dark GREY/GREEN OPEN military jacket over a WHITE OPEN-NECK inner shirt/collar, NO NECKTIE. Retain only source-exposed small gold/red shoulder fitting areas along crop, no hidden chest pins or medals. Keep source lowward head tilt and actual lighting.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Do not copy the human long neck or angular jaw into mascot anatomy; fit the source collar to the compact rounded head. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed unchanged small source, full returned master, paired sheet and white/cyan/alpha panels. Bare wavy black/grey hair, downward head tilt, stern closed mouth, open green military jacket, white OPEN-NECK shirt with NO TIE and limited gold/red shoulder areas are retained. Two clear defects remain: the actual dark eyebrow HAIR visible in the source is omitted and replaced by bare yellow brow ridges; a long triangular yellow throat descends into the open shirt. Queue a separate repair of this exact raw master restoring real dark eyebrow hair and a compact round chin/very short broad neck with the white open collar fitted upward around it. Keep the actual open shirt and NO TIE, no new cap/glasses or closed tunic. Original photographic backing/frame/note remain opaque without visible holes.
